description: Aggregated task panel for Notion action items, backed by the unified work-item provider.

parameters.name: WorkItemSource
parameters.description: Unified work-item source used to query and update tasks.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Task provider used to query and update tasks.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the panel close button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToBlock
parameters.description: Raised when a source task is selected for navigation. Args are page id and block id.
